Author: ShaalaXIV
Name: Synastry
Description: A Penumbra animation launcher for organizing, pairing, and synchronizing multi-actor animations.
Changelog: A redesigned interface built on the game's own fonts. Paired animations now line up automatically through Simple Heels, locked emotes use the replacements most players already own, and rooms wait until everyone's animation files have arrived before starting. "Let the room pick my role" is now Free Use Mode.
